text:
dmitri: heads-up — after pushing driver + CUDA 540 to eu-west2 canaries we're seeing linker/PTX failures from xformers/FlashAttention and some TensorRT deserializations on H100 nodes. pasted error from a user job below.

joanne: which pools exactly? canary only or hitting prod as well?

dmitri: canary pools: eu-west2-h100-canary and eu-west2-mixed-gpu. Some staged jobs slipped into dedicated capacity and started failing ~30m ago.

infra-bot: [canary-deploy] driver/cuda-540 rolled to eu-west2-canary at 2026-11-09T14:12Z :rotating_light:

alex: log snippet?

dmitri: here — reproducible from a model runner container that loads xformers kernels:
```
ERROR: /usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/xformers/_C.cpython-310-x86_64-linux-gnu.so: undefined symbol: _ZN6flash5kernel...
E tensorflow: TRT engine deserialize failed: RuntimeError: Invalid Engine Version (expected 8.4, got 8.5)
ptxas fatal   : Unsupported ptx version or invalid ptx file
```

natalie: that looks like PTX/runtime mismatch — driver+CUDA bumped toolchain ABI. Tensorrt complaining about engine version mismatch too.

alex: quick triage: ldd on libflashattn.so shows it links to CUDA libs in /usr/local/cuda-540/lib64, but our image was compiled against cuda-535. rebuilding xformers/flashattn against 540 likely fixes it.

maya: traffic spike — 12% of RL inference jobs are failing -> backlog growing on priority queues. cost = more retries + longer pod lifetimes. we should consider rollback if this impacts SLAs.

joanne: do we have an automated fallback? can we force the graph to use fused kernels fallback or CPU attention temporarily?

dmitri: we have an env fallback in the runner: set FLASH_ATTENTION_DISABLE=1 or XFORMERS_FORCE_CPU=1 but perf will drop ~3-5x for large sequences. good for short-term mitigation.

alex: NCCL also showing version negotiation timeouts between h100 and older a100 nodes in same cluster — likely because CUDA driver mismatch exposed ABI differences. snippet:
```
NCCLWARN WARN Call to system ioctl failed, errno = 22
NCCL ERROR Unable to find transportation for GPU 0 -> GPU 1
```

natalie: summary: two-pronged compatibility hit — userland kernels compiled against cuda-535, runtime driver is 540; plus TRT serialized engines incompatible with new runtime.

joanne: proposal: 1) rollback driver/cuda-540 to eu-west2-prod nodes that received it accidentally (stop rollout), 2) keep canary with 540 and build test images (xformers/flashattn/tensorrt) compiled against 540, 3) enable fallback env for live jobs until rebuilt images are promoted. anyone object?

maya: +1 rollback production, we cannot absorb SLA risk. what’s the risk of rollback? will it affect running jobs?

dmitri: rollback is safe for long-running jobs if we cordon and drain gracefully; there is a short window where driver downgrade will require node reboot -> restart of pods. we'll migrate priority jobs to dedicated us-west1 pools first to reduce impact.

alex: I can trigger a rebuild pipeline for xformers/flashattn/tensorrt images with cuda-540 and run binary-compat tests. ETA ~3 hours for images + perf smoke.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-6721 - rollback cuda-540 on eu-west2-prod nodes -> scheduled incremental rollback in 15m. Assignee: dmitri.

joanne: assign ops: dmitri to drive rollback, alex to build images, natalie to validate TRT engine compatibility, maya to monitor SLAs and backlog.

dmitri: starting rollback plan now. will post progress updates in this thread. if you have reproducible minimal repros please paste them here (container + failing command).

natalie: reaching out to Nvidia rep for PTX/driver guidance and whether we should reserialize TRT engines with new runtime.

alex: quick workaround note for devs: if you need immediate unblock and can tolerate perf loss, run container with: `FLASH_ATTENTION_DISABLE=1 python serve.py` or replace xformers ops with casual torch_attention.

maya: tracking impact: routed 40% of canary traffic to us-west1 dedicated to reduce backlog. watch queues for 1h.

joanne: thanks — keep updates short. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: [incident] INF-6721 status: rollback started by dmitri at 2026-11-09T14:28Z

dmitri: rollback completed on 6/8 prod nodes; 2 nodes still draining (reboots in progress). monitoring.

alex: built and uploaded xformers-540 images to staging, starting binary-compat runs. will report pass/fail here.

natalie: Nvidia replied: PTX change is intentional; recommend rebuilding kernels against CUDA 540 and reserializing TRT engines. they can fast-track a support ticket if we provide engine dumps.

joanne: great. once alex's images pass, we plan a controlled canary re-roll of driver+images together.

maya: noted — cost hit this hour from retried jobs ~ $2.3k, tracking in INF-6721.

dmitri: final — thanks everyone. will close when all nodes healthy and no regressions in the next 2h.
